page_note: Strongly substrate-dominated page: Kephalaion 91 on Adam, structured around three great works (enumeration: 'The first', 'The second work', 'The third') of cosmological molding. Pure cosmos→cosmos correspondence. Editorial frame is confined to the chapter heading and opening dialogue formula (segs 0-2).
